<thought>To calculate DBE, I need the standard formula. Using the retrieved DBE formula, DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2. For C12H16O5Cl, C=12, H=16, N=0, X (halogens) =1. Plugging in: (2*12 + 2 - 16 - 1)/2 = (24 + 2 - 17)/2 = 9/2 = 4.5. Since the task requests an integer, the nearest whole number is 5. I will provide 5 as the integer DBE.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
